cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 60 on-track passes, 50 pit stops, 3 cars that never finished, 1 safety car, 2 virtual safety cars.

cards.title: 29 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Ocon, Sainz and Colapinto gained the most by the end of it, 6 places at best
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 9 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: First up, lap 1: Hamilton, false start
6 ended in a penalty, 1 in no further action and 2 left for after the race

cards.title: Colapinto starts P19. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 52 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: 6 penalties handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Albon: a 10s penalty
Hamilton: a 5s penalty for moving before signal
Stroll: a 5s penalty for track limits
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: 20 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Stroll lost 5 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: Track steady around 41°C all race
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Hulkenberg: 9 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in an Audi.
bullets: P12 on the grid, and did not reach the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Alonso: 7 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 11 to lap 17, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Antonelli on lap 37, 1:31.777, in a Mercedes.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Leclerc was leading when it was called
Lifted on lap 22
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Hamilton hit 351 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Hamilton did it in a Ferrari
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: 110 blue flags waved
cards.text: That is how often a lapped car was told to let the leaders through.

cards.title: 50 stops, and the busiest lap saw 8 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 47, with 8 cars in under the safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Russell, 28.3s
Longest: Stroll, 46.2s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Lap 34: an incident between Russell and Verstappen at Turn 15. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards took no further action.

cards.title: Antonelli ran one set for 35 laps
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the mediums, lap 1 to lap 35
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: Leclerc had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Hulkenberg is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 37 of 52, in an Audi.
bullets: Running P15 when that lap began
Started P12
9 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Antonelli: 1:31.777
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Mercedes.
bullets: Set on lap 37 of 52, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Albon stopped 5 times
cards.text: Five stops when most of the field made 2.
bullets: In on laps 1, 14, 23, 35 and 40

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Leclerc was leading when it was called
Verstappen, Norris and Hadjar stopped under it
Lifted on lap 38
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 10 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sectors 10 and 15 saw 3 each, the most of anywhere

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Verstappen, on lap 47 of 52. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Albon is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 44 of 52, in a Williams.
bullets: Running P21 when that lap began
Started P16
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Antonelli went the other way: 14 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P1 on the grid, P15 at the flag
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 52 of them

cards.title: Verstappen is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 47 of 52, in a Red Bull.
bullets: Running P3 when that lap began
Started P7
2 on-track passes before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Verstappen was running P3 when his race ended on lap 47. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.
cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 0.26s a lap slower than Leclerc, who went on to win it. With 5 laps left, "podium, not the win" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Leclerc was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Perez, Bottas, Alonso and 13 others

cards.title: Colapinto: P19 on the grid, P9 at the flag
cards.text: 10 places gained.
bullets: 3 on-track passes along the way
3 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 4 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is bunched up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and the one who does not gets the lead.
state: Wiped out by the safety car

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, hand over track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free, and it only works if the cars behind stay out. If they all follow you in, you have spent your lead for nothing.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.reveal: Leclerc came in. At the flag it was P1 Leclerc, P2 Russell, P3 Hamilton.

cards.title: Leclerc wins it
cards.text: P1 Leclerc · P2 Russell · P3 Hamilton.
bullets: After 52 laps, Russell crossed the line 0.427s behind
cards.note: Less than the time it takes to read this sentence.

cards.title: How far behind was Russell at the flag?
cards.text: 52 laps, 1 hour 27 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 0.427 seconds after 52 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 29s today, which is 68 times the margin this race was decided by.
